trap.label: comparativo/superlativo
trap.wrong: TV is the most popular of the world.
trap.right: TV is the most popular source.
trap.why: Em português “o mais popular do mundo”; o brasileiro usa of the world com source. Aqui o foco: the most/the least + adjetivo, com the obrigatório.

mcq.q: Contrast: Radio is **___** less common than TV.

fix.right: TV is the most popular source.

fix.why: Superlativo de baixa intensidade: the least.

fix.wrong: About the half of people use phones.
fix.right: About half of people use phones.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com superlativo: “TV is more popular than radio.” (…the most popular)
Reescreva com least: “Radio is the most uncommon.” → “Radio is the … common.”
